page.overview:
Who is Rina Hafden?

Rina Hafden is an Aes Sedai and for a while a loyalist Sitter of the Green Ajah.

She is described as being elegant despite being stocky. She has a square face and an upturned nose. She is a fierce, tenacious and determined woman, not easily daunted.

Rina has a strength in the One Power of, average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

Rina is 77 years old. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in the series. After spending nine years as novice and eight as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year 955 NE.
